- Doesn't precipitate with Ba+2 (Ba(H2PO4)2 is soluble)
- Doesn't precipitate with Ag+ (AgH2PO4 is soluble)

- pH 5 → acidic anion

- White ppt with KOH → Sr(OH)2
- The acidic pH rules out NO3- (which would be neutral)
